speaker_title: Address by Mr. Lotay Tshering, Prime Minister of the Kingdom of Bhutan

paragraphs.text: Mr. President,
paragraphs.raw_text: Mr. President,

paragraphs.text: Secretary General,
paragraphs.raw_text: Secretary General,

paragraphs.text: Excellencies,
paragraphs.raw_text: Excellencies,

paragraphs.text: Distinguished Delegates,
paragraphs.raw_text: Distinguished Delegates,

paragraphs.text: I bring you warm greetings from His Majesty The King, Her Majesty The Queen and the people of Bhutan, the land of Gross National Happiness.
paragraphs.raw_text:
I bring you warm greetings from His Majesty The King, Her Majesty The 
Queen and the people of Bhutan, the land of Gross National Happiness.

paragraphs.text: I begin with prayers for all the precious lives lost to the pandemic and sincerely hope it comes to an end very soon.
paragraphs.raw_text:
I begin with prayers for all the precious lives lost to the pandemic and sincerely 
hope it comes to an end very soon.

paragraphs.text: Congratulations Your Excellency Mr. Abdulla Shahid for the presidentship. I assure you my full support as you assume this role at a critical time. I also extend my gratitude to the 75th President for conducting the last session successfully.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Congratulations Your Excellency Mr. Abdulla Shahid for the presidentship. I 
assure you my full support as you assume this role at a critical time. I also extend my 
gratitude to the 75th President for conducting the last session successfully.

paragraphs.text: I take this opportunity to congratulate Your Excellency Mr. António Guterres, on your re-election as the Secretary-General of the United Nations. Nobody else can give us better hope and guidance to build back from this pandemic than Your Excellency.
paragraphs.raw_text:
I take this opportunity to congratulate Your Excellency Mr. António Guterres, 
on your re-election as the Secretary-General of the United Nations. Nobody else 
can give us better hope and guidance to build back from this pandemic than 
Your Excellency.

paragraphs.text: I would also like to thank Your Excellency as well as Prime Minister Johnson for organising the Leaders Roundtable on Climate Change five days ago. I spoke on behalf of the 46 LDCs and we are already excited for concrete results out of the COP26 in the coming month.
paragraphs.raw_text:
I would also like to thank Your Excellency as well as Prime Minister Johnson 
for organising the Leaders Roundtable on Climate Change five days ago. I spoke 
on behalf of the 46 LDCs and we are already excited for concrete results out of the 
COP26 in the coming month.

paragraphs.text: I would like to inform the august gathering that this year marks the 50th anniversary of Bhutan’s membership to the UN. I was excited to attend the session and celebrate the milestone with you all, but the situation as you know did not favour our physical participation.
paragraphs.raw_text:
I would like to inform the august gathering that this year marks the 
50th anniversary of Bhutan’s membership to the UN. I was excited to attend the 
session and celebrate the milestone with you all, but the situation as you know did not 
favour our physical participation.

paragraphs.text: I thank everyone at the organization and all the members for enriching Bhutan’s five decades of journey with the UN.
paragraphs.raw_text:
I thank everyone at the organization and all the members for enriching Bhutan’s 
five decades of journey with the UN.

paragraphs.text: We have come a long way. The fact that we are ready to graduate from the LDC category is a clear indication that our efforts together have born results.
paragraphs.raw_text:
We have come a long way. The fact that we are ready to graduate from the LDC 
category is a clear indication that our efforts together have born results.

paragraphs.text: In addition to the UN and other partners, I thank the Government of India for your unconditional support all these years.
paragraphs.raw_text:
In addition to the UN and other partners, I thank the Government of India for 
your unconditional support all these years.

paragraphs.text: We will continue to work closely with all our partners.
paragraphs.raw_text: We will continue to work closely with all our partners.

paragraphs.text: Please allow me to talk a little more on the last five decades.
paragraphs.raw_text: Please allow me to talk a little more on the last five decades.

paragraphs.text: During the 50 years, the global poverty rate dropped from 52 to 9 per cent. Life expectancy increased from 57 to almost 73 years. Bhutan’s was just 40 when we joined the UN. The infant mortality rate decreased from 98 to 27 deaths per 1000 live births.
paragraphs.raw_text:
During the 50 years, the global poverty rate dropped from 52 to 9 per cent. 
Life expectancy increased from 57 to almost 73 years. Bhutan’s was just 40 when we 
joined the UN. The infant mortality rate decreased from 98 to 27 deaths per 1000 
live births.

paragraphs.text: Similarly, the maternal mortality reduced from almost 400 to 200 deaths per 100,000 live births. The global literacy rate spiked from 67 to 86 percent. Without the coordinated global efforts through the UN, these progresses would not have been
paragraphs.raw_text:
Similarly, the maternal mortality reduced from almost 400 to 200 deaths per 
100,000 live births. The global literacy rate spiked from 67 to 86 percent. Without 
the coordinated global efforts through the UN, these progresses would not have been

paragraphs.text: possible or worse, many nations could have slipped backwards. We are thankful that Bhutan has comparatively benefitted more.
paragraphs.raw_text:
possible or worse, many nations could have slipped backwards. We are thankful that 
Bhutan has comparatively benefitted more.

paragraphs.text: In the last 50 years, Bhutan was blessed with three successive monarchs.
paragraphs.raw_text: In the last 50 years, Bhutan was blessed with three successive monarchs.

paragraphs.text: It was His Late Majesty the Third King who worked tirelessly to install Bhutan into the UN. It was a historic move to establish global diplomacy and harness meaningful friendship. The farsighted monarch led the country on the path of modernization, with focus on modern education and progressive techniques in all spheres.
paragraphs.raw_text:
It was His Late Majesty the Third King who worked tirelessly to install 
Bhutan into the UN. It was a historic move to establish global diplomacy and 
harness meaningful friendship. The farsighted monarch led the country on the path 
of modernization, with focus on modern education and progressive techniques in 
all spheres.

paragraphs.text: When the Fourth King took over soon after, he came with the profound development philosophy of Gross National Happiness in as early as 1972.
paragraphs.raw_text:
When the Fourth King took over soon after, he came with the profound 
development philosophy of Gross National Happiness in as early as 1972.

paragraphs.text: As the term “GNH” became more pronounced over the years, the world appreciated its relevance in the sustainable and holistic format as opposed to the conventional GDP growth.
paragraphs.raw_text:
As the term “GNH” became more pronounced over the years, the world 
appreciated its relevance in the sustainable and holistic format as opposed to the 
conventional GDP growth.

paragraphs.text: I am happy to see this concept reflected in Secretary General’s “Our Common Agenda” report, which I would like to touch upon later.
paragraphs.raw_text:
I am happy to see this concept reflected in Secretary General’s “Our Common 
Agenda” report, which I would like to touch upon later.

paragraphs.text: The nation lived through major socioeconomic development, championing in conservation efforts and strengthening global ties. The world will recall that during the peak of his reign, our fourth King stepped down to offer the throne to his son and despite public resistance, he ushered in democratic transition.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The nation lived through major socioeconomic development, championing in 
conservation efforts and strengthening global ties. The world will recall that during 
the peak of his reign, our fourth King stepped down to offer the throne to his son and 
despite public resistance, he ushered in democratic transition.

paragraphs.text: Destined to carry forward the legacy, Bhutan received a young and dynamic monarch, His Majesty The King, in 2006. We embarked on a new chapter. Just under two decades, people of Bhutan relished the reign of a King who was caring, learned and astute.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Destined to carry forward the legacy, Bhutan received a young and dynamic 
monarch, His Majesty The King, in 2006. We embarked on a new chapter. Just under 
two decades, people of Bhutan relished the reign of a King who was caring, learned 
and astute.

paragraphs.text: For generations, Bhutanese have always loved and revered our Kings … for the simple reason that our monarchs have been selfless for the nation and the people. But when COVID-19 crisis unfolded, for Bhutan, we uncovered the true essence of our King’s leadership.
paragraphs.raw_text:
For generations, Bhutanese have always loved and revered our Kings … for 
the simple reason that our monarchs have been selfless for the nation and the people. 
But when COVID-19 crisis unfolded, for Bhutan, we uncovered the true essence of 
our King’s leadership.

paragraphs.text: In him, we saw a son who ensured the old and vulnerable people were protected from the infection. In him, we saw a brother who travelled tirelessly throughout the country, uplifting the spirits of the front-liners, and working alongside to protect the people.
paragraphs.raw_text:
In him, we saw a son who ensured the old and vulnerable people were protected 
from the infection. In him, we saw a brother who travelled tirelessly throughout the 
country, uplifting the spirits of the front-liners, and working alongside to protect 
the people.

paragraphs.text: In His Majesty, we saw a parent who ensured the livelihoods of all those affected. The supports ranged from emotional to cash to food. But of all, we saw a noble being who led with science and wisdom on one hand and care and compassion on the other.
paragraphs.raw_text:
In His Majesty, we saw a parent who ensured the livelihoods of all those 
affected. The supports ranged from emotional to cash to food. But of all, we saw a 
noble being who led with science and wisdom on one hand and care and compassion 
on the other.

paragraphs.text: Complementing all the noble efforts, Her Majesty The Queen showed personal care and initiated targeted inventions for the vulnerable sections of our society with emphasis on mental health care and services in the country.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Complementing all the noble efforts, Her Majesty The Queen showed personal 
care and initiated targeted inventions for the vulnerable sections of our society with 
emphasis on mental health care and services in the country.

paragraphs.text: When the world was dealing with the unprecedented plight that questioned our survival and livelihood daily, we sailed through with a minimum scratch from the pandemic. To update, we have seen only three COVID deaths and slightly over 2,500 cases so far, most of which were imported cases.
paragraphs.raw_text:
When the world was dealing with the unprecedented plight that questioned our 
survival and livelihood daily, we sailed through with a minimum scratch from the 
pandemic. To update, we have seen only three COVID deaths and slightly over 2,500 
cases so far, most of which were imported cases.

paragraphs.text: Similarly, our vaccination coverage for 12 years and above is almost 80 percent, as I speak. Despite being resource constraint, we have not compromised on the quality and standards of the COVID measures.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Similarly, our vaccination coverage for 12 years and above is almost 80 
percent, as I speak. Despite being resource constraint, we have not compromised on 
the quality and standards of the COVID measures.

paragraphs.text: Let me also mention that in the entire process of battling the pandemic, we ensured the routine health services were delivered uninterrupted. Besides the regular vaccination programs, we introduced HPV vaccines for the first time for our boys and flu shots for everyone amid the pandemic.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Let me also mention that in the entire process of battling the pandemic, we 
ensured the routine health services were delivered uninterrupted. Besides the regular 
vaccination programs, we introduced HPV vaccines for the first time for our boys 
and flu shots for everyone amid the pandemic.

paragraphs.text: We also launched nationwide program on prevention and early detection of the three most common cancers in Bhutan-stomach, breast and cervical.
paragraphs.raw_text:
We also launched nationwide program on prevention and early detection of the 
three most common cancers in Bhutan-stomach, breast and cervical.

paragraphs.text: All these are aligned with the royal visions enshrined in the Constitution that mandates the State to provide free health and education. His Majesty tells us that quality health and education, made affordable and available to all, are the biggest social levellers.
paragraphs.raw_text:
All these are aligned with the royal visions enshrined in the Constitution that 
mandates the State to provide free health and education. His Majesty tells us that 
quality health and education, made affordable and available to all, are the biggest 
social levellers.

paragraphs.text: Excellencies,
paragraphs.raw_text: Excellencies,

paragraphs.text: Just like the rest of the world, we are also looking at the pandemic as an opportunity to reset ourselves. The process to overhaul the civil service in consonance with education reform is underway. This is an unprecedented move.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Just like the rest of the world, we are also looking at the pandemic as an 
opportunity to reset ourselves. The process to overhaul the civil service in consonance 
with education reform is underway. This is an unprecedented move.

paragraphs.text: A nationwide roll-out of Bhutan baccalaureate system is in progress following successful trial of a formative education system in the last ten years.
paragraphs.raw_text:
A nationwide roll-out of Bhutan baccalaureate system is in progress following 
successful trial of a formative education system in the last ten years.

paragraphs.text: Knowing that the path ahead is ICT driven, we have started digital initiatives with the ultimate goal for everyone in Bhutan to have a digital ID, as a build-up for Big Data system.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Knowing that the path ahead is ICT driven, we have started digital initiatives 
with the ultimate goal for everyone in Bhutan to have a digital ID, as a build-up for 
Big Data system.

paragraphs.text: Some other components are ICTisation of schools, Integrated Taxation System, and electronic Patient Information management.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Some other components are ICTisation of schools, Integrated Taxation System, 
and electronic Patient Information management.

paragraphs.text: On the other hand, our Central Bank is also piloting a project on digital Ngultrum, Bhutan’s currency, using block chain technology. This is to adapt with the overall ICT transformation and harness technology for a 21st-century Bhutan.
paragraphs.raw_text:
On the other hand, our Central Bank is also piloting a project on digital 
Ngultrum, Bhutan’s currency, using block chain technology. This is to adapt with the 
overall ICT transformation and harness technology for a 21st-century Bhutan.

paragraphs.text: Here, let me share that it is as though His Majesty saw the pandemic coming. In 2011, an extensive program that engaged citizens in a greater role of nation building, calling it De-Suung, the Guardians of Peace, was started.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Here, let me share that it is as though His Majesty saw the pandemic coming. In 
2011, an extensive program that engaged citizens in a greater role of nation building, 
calling it De-Suung, the Guardians of Peace, was started.

paragraphs.text: It recharged the entire spirit of volunteerism, opened world of opportunities for our youth and injected sense of purpose and responsibility. Thousands of youth were involved in the programs that created a mass societal shift.
paragraphs.raw_text:
It recharged the entire spirit of volunteerism, opened world of opportunities 
for our youth and injected sense of purpose and responsibility. Thousands of youth 
were involved in the programs that created a mass societal shift.

paragraphs.text: When disease entered the country, the De-Suungs in their orange uniform were helping guard the borders and entry points, ensuring everyone followed the COVID-19 norms and even became a part of the paramedics. This made a huge impact in efficient management of the pandemic.
paragraphs.raw_text:
When disease entered the country, the De-Suungs in their orange uniform 
were helping guard the borders and entry points, ensuring everyone followed the 
COVID-19 norms and even became a part of the paramedics. This made a huge 
impact in efficient management of the pandemic.

paragraphs.text: In another unique transformative step, the De-Suungs when not a part of COVID-19 related duties, are engaged in various skilling and re-skilling programs across the nation.
paragraphs.raw_text:
In another unique transformative step, the De-Suungs when not a part of 
COVID-19 related duties, are engaged in various skilling and re-skilling programs 
across the nation.

paragraphs.text: We know that the pandemic has forced many out of jobs and their basic skills have become irrelevant.
paragraphs.raw_text:
We know that the pandemic has forced many out of jobs and their basic skills 
have become irrelevant.

paragraphs.text: The ILO projects the global shortfall of jobs to be 75 million this year and 23 million in 2022.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The ILO projects the global shortfall of jobs to be 75 million this year and 
23 million in 2022.

paragraphs.text: This means unless we re-tool ourselves in keeping with the change, it will be difficult to find gainful employment and other opportunities for many.
paragraphs.raw_text:
This means unless we re-tool ourselves in keeping with the change, it will be 
difficult to find gainful employment and other opportunities for many.

paragraphs.text: The ongoing youth engagement programs are major steps to recover from the pandemic.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The ongoing youth engagement programs are major steps to recover from 
the pandemic.

paragraphs.text: While the effects may not be immediate, down the years, it would have been one of the main reasons for us to come out of the pandemic stronger.
paragraphs.raw_text:
While the effects may not be immediate, down the years, it would have been 
one of the main reasons for us to come out of the pandemic stronger.

paragraphs.text: I feel when Bhutan’s socioeconomic transformation is reviewed later, our human development initiatives, guided by our King, will be the chapter that would have truly steered our nation into the 21st century.
paragraphs.raw_text:
I feel when Bhutan’s socioeconomic transformation is reviewed later, our 
human development initiatives, guided by our King, will be the chapter that would 
have truly steered our nation into the 21st century.

paragraphs.text: I am highly appreciative of the fact that the UN instruments are sensitive in picking this up. A special recognition was awarded to His Majesty for his leadership in advancing human development and the wellbeing of Bhutanese people in 2019.
paragraphs.raw_text:
I am highly appreciative of the fact that the UN instruments are sensitive in 
picking this up. A special recognition was awarded to His Majesty for his leadership 
in advancing human development and the wellbeing of Bhutanese people in 2019.

paragraphs.text: Excellencies,
paragraphs.raw_text: Excellencies,

paragraphs.text: We have immense lessons to draw from the pandemic, be it at national or global level. It has uncovered weaknesses and potentials of many nations and societies. But one lesson that we all must keep in mind is to be prepared with a more resilient system for future.
paragraphs.raw_text:
We have immense lessons to draw from the pandemic, be it at national or global 
level. It has uncovered weaknesses and potentials of many nations and societies. But 
one lesson that we all must keep in mind is to be prepared with a more resilient 
system for future.

paragraphs.text: The nomenclature of SARS-CoV-2 and COVID-19 clearly indicate that there will be successive outbreaks of infectious diseases. It is a matter of when. I mean nobody knows where SARS-CoV-3 is getting incubated.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The nomenclature of SARS-CoV-2 and COVID-19 clearly indicate that there 
will be successive outbreaks of infectious diseases. It is a matter of when. I mean 
nobody knows where SARS-CoV-3 is getting incubated.

paragraphs.text: Therefore, our focus to build back better can never be good if we don’t emphasise on health and quality healthcare that is easily accessible and affordable by everyone.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Therefore, our focus to build back better can never be good if we don’t 
emphasise on health and quality healthcare that is easily accessible and affordable 
by everyone.

paragraphs.text: We must also be mindful that immediate disease outbreak could be potentially from the pandemic induced starvation and poverty. The pandemic has disrupted the already weak global food system. The Asia-Pacific region alone has 90 million people pushed back into extreme poverty in the aftermath of the current health crisis.
paragraphs.raw_text:
We must also be mindful that immediate disease outbreak could be potentially 
from the pandemic induced starvation and poverty. The pandemic has disrupted 
the already weak global food system. The Asia-Pacific region alone has 90 million 
people pushed back into extreme poverty in the aftermath of the current health crisis.

paragraphs.text: I shared my concern during the UN food system summit the day before. Forget meeting the nutritional requirements, we are struggling to ensure adequate quantity.
paragraphs.raw_text:
I shared my concern during the UN food system summit the day before. Forget 
meeting the nutritional requirements, we are struggling to ensure adequate quantity.

paragraphs.text: We must coordinate clear action plans to meet the immediate food shortage and long term sustenance plan.
paragraphs.raw_text:
We must coordinate clear action plans to meet the immediate food shortage 
and long term sustenance plan.

paragraphs.text: In all the discussions about food security, one immediate challenge besides the pandemic is the climate change that has tested the resilience of the food we grow as well as the patience of the growers.
paragraphs.raw_text:
In all the discussions about food security, one immediate challenge besides the 
pandemic is the climate change that has tested the resilience of the food we grow as 
well as the patience of the growers.

paragraphs.text: Which is why it is time for action now. On Bhutan’s part, our visionary monarchs have maintained high legal standards to safeguard our natural heritage.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Which is why it is time for action now. On Bhutan’s part, our visionary 
monarchs have maintained high legal standards to safeguard our natural heritage.

paragraphs.text: We have a dedicated chapter on environment in our Constitution, which mandates 60 per cent forest coverage and maintain inter-generational equity of our natural resources.
paragraphs.raw_text:
We have a dedicated chapter on environment in our Constitution, which 
mandates 60 per cent forest coverage and maintain inter-generational equity of our 
natural resources.

paragraphs.text: We have more than half the country as protected areas. In order to safeguard the health of the protected areas, and the livelihood of people living there, a Royal Charter was issued for an innovative funding mechanism called Bhutan for Life. We consider these as our eternal NDCs from Bhutan.
paragraphs.raw_text:
We have more than half the country as protected areas. In order to safeguard 
the health of the protected areas, and the livelihood of people living there, a Royal 
Charter was issued for an innovative funding mechanism called Bhutan for Life. We 
consider these as our eternal NDCs from Bhutan.

paragraphs.text: If we mean what we say about working for the next generation, we must talk about tough climate laws as a component of NDCs from all countries.
paragraphs.raw_text:
If we mean what we say about working for the next generation, we must talk 
about tough climate laws as a component of NDCs from all countries.

paragraphs.text: Excellencies
paragraphs.raw_text: Excellencies

paragraphs.text: Despite being a small developing nation, as a GNH country, we always believe in global peace and harmony. Bhutan joined the peacekeeping fraternity in 2014. Since then, our involvement with UN Peace Keeping has grown.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Despite being a small developing nation, as a GNH country, we always believe 
in global peace and harmony. Bhutan joined the peacekeeping fraternity in 2014. 
Since then, our involvement with UN Peace Keeping has grown.

paragraphs.text: We are now set to deploy a Bhutanese Quick Reaction Force for the first time this year. I thank the UN for trusting us. I am confident that our troops will live up to His Majesty’s aspirations of serving with distinction and honour.
paragraphs.raw_text:
We are now set to deploy a Bhutanese Quick Reaction Force for the first time 
this year. I thank the UN for trusting us. I am confident that our troops will live up to 
His Majesty’s aspirations of serving with distinction and honour.

paragraphs.text: In conclusion, we all know that COVID-19 will leave behind a different world. But what sort of a world we want lies in our hands.
paragraphs.raw_text:
In conclusion, we all know that COVID-19 will leave behind a different world. 
But what sort of a world we want lies in our hands.

paragraphs.text: Mr. Secretary General’s report titled “Our Common Agenda” offers all of us a good reference point for our collective progress.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Mr. Secretary General’s report titled “Our Common Agenda” offers all of us a 
good reference point for our collective progress.

paragraphs.text: For this, I thank the Secretary-General for coming out with this comprehensive and bold report for a greener and safer world. Please know that Bhutan is committed to working with other Member States in advancing the ideas in the report. We have full confidence in your leadership to spearhead Our Common Agenda.
paragraphs.raw_text:
For this, I thank the Secretary-General for coming out with this comprehensive 
and bold report for a greener and safer world. Please know that Bhutan is committed 
to working with other Member States in advancing the ideas in the report. We have 
full confidence in your leadership to spearhead Our Common Agenda.

paragraphs.text: I want to share that it was almost as if the theme of the general debate was designed for Bhutan. It gave me an opportunity to reflect on our hope as a nation.
paragraphs.raw_text:
I want to share that it was almost as if the theme of the general debate was 
designed for Bhutan. It gave me an opportunity to reflect on our hope as a nation.

paragraphs.text: The pandemic brought out the very essence of GNH, which seeks collective happiness and not just of oneself. It calls for us to act in unity.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The pandemic brought out the very essence of GNH, which seeks collective 
happiness and not just of oneself. It calls for us to act in unity.

paragraphs.text: For Bhutan, everyone came forward to show solidarity to shield our country from the pandemic under His Majesty’s leadership. If not, this small, resource constraint country would have been crushed in the stampede of the COVID19 pandemic.
paragraphs.raw_text:
For Bhutan, everyone came forward to show solidarity to shield our country from 
the pandemic under His Majesty’s leadership. If not, this small, resource constraint 
country would have been crushed in the stampede of the COVID19 pandemic.

paragraphs.text: Our unique system is beyond conventional definition of progress and prosperity. A country’s future is not just founded based on economic might and technological advancements but on the integral values of human bonding and respect. And in this, His Majesty is our true hope and our future.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Our unique system is beyond conventional definition of progress and prosperity. 
A country’s future is not just founded based on economic might and technological 
advancements but on the integral values of human bonding and respect. And in this, 
His Majesty is our true hope and our future.

paragraphs.text: I feel this is our biggest strength to come out of any adversities, just as we did this time.
paragraphs.raw_text:
I feel this is our biggest strength to come out of any adversities, just as we did 
this time.

paragraphs.text: With prayers from Bhutan to the rest of the world I thank you all for listening. I wish the 76th session of the UN General Assembly every success.
paragraphs.raw_text:
With prayers from Bhutan to the rest of the world I thank you all for listening. 
I wish the 76th session of the UN General Assembly every success.

paragraphs.text: Thank you and Tashi Delek.
